column1: # *** THE MARRIAGE OF LUIS LERENA AND JUSTINIANA LENGUAS - 3 MARCH 1842. ***
# Found and read 14 September 2026. Index ark 1:1:X9G7-T3FP; image ark 3:1:939D-V7SM-N, level 13.
# Indexed by FamilySearch under "Argentina, Capital Federal, Catholic Church Records" at San Miguel
# Arcangel, San Nicolas, Buenos Aires - but the officiant describes himself as "Cura Rector de la
# Parroquia de Nuestra Senora del Carmen del SALTO ORIENTAL DEL URUGUAY". The act was recorded in an
# Argentine book; where the ceremony happened is not settled by what is legible here, and is left open.
# *** THIS IS THE GENERATION ABOVE THE MONTEVIDEO TRUNK, MARRYING - and it was reached by searching
# the surname LENGUAS in ARGENTINA, which nobody had thought to do. ***

column3: *** THE FIRST CHILD OF THE MARRIAGE ARRIVES SIXTEEN MONTHS LATER: *** Justiniana Mauricia Maxima, born 30 July 1843. This line used to read "Eleven months before Luis Eugenio was born on 9 February 1843. The fit is exact." - and it was resting on a date retracted on 14 September. Luis Eugenio was born 9 February 1845, thirty-five months after the wedding, and he is the second child, not the first. *** The marriage still fits; it fits a different child. ***

column2: D. LUIS LERENA, natural de la Ciudad de Montevideo, de TREINTA ANOS de edad
column3: *** Born about 1812 *** - the published trees say 1811, and they are right to within a year. And he is stated MONTEVIDEAN by birth.

column2: *** "hijo legitimo de D. SANCHO y Dona MARIA FERNANDEZ" ***
column3: *** SANCHO FOR THE THIRD TIME, and this is the EARLIEST of the three acts. *** The 1850 baptism of Alberto Octavio said Sancho; this says Sancho in 1842. Against them stand only the two 1846 entries reading "Francisco", which say of themselves that they are later TRANSCRIPTS from a legajo. The apex of this archive's tree is now as well attested as anything in it.

column2: *** "desposé en SEGUNDAS NUPCIAS ... VIUDO de Dona CAROLINA D[i]lle" *** - the surname is not confidently legible
column3: *** LUIS LERENA WAS A WIDOWER, AND THIS ARCHIVE HAD NO IDEA. *** He had married before 1842 a Carolina who was dead by then. If that marriage produced children, there is an ENTIRE HALF-SIBLING GENERATION to Luis Eugenio and Gilberto that nothing here has ever looked for.

column2: JUSTINIANA LENGUAS, natural de la Ciudad de Montevideo, de VEINTE ANOS de edad
column3: Born about 1822 - agreeing exactly with her stated 79 in 1901 and 87 in 1908.

column2: *** "hija legitima del Sr. GRAL. [Pedro] LENGUAS y Dona CARMEN GONZALEZ" ***
column3: *** THE GENERAL, CONFIRMED IN A SECOND ACT *** and four years earlier than the 1846 baptism that first gave him the rank. FamilySearch's index renders the words "Gral. D. Pedro" as a forename, "Geraldo Dios Lenguas" - which is how a rank becomes a christian name.

column2: a quienes les fueron dispensadas las tres proclamas conciliares
column3: They were dispensed the three banns - the ordinary dispensation, not a consanguinity one.
